Privacy Policy

Effective Date: November 19, 2026 · Operated by TruthOfMarket Research (Independent Market Data & Educational Research)

1. Minimal Data Collection Principle

TruthOfMarket Research is architected with privacy-by-design. Visitors can run our 4-Step Historical Sector Backtest Explorer and view their free historical study summary immediately without creating a password or sharing brokerage account credentials.

  • Passwordless Research Note Opt-In: If you voluntarily subscribe to save your historical study summary or receive our morning market data newsletter, we store only your email address, optional nickname, and chosen study topic to deliver requested educational notes. Every email includes a 1-click Unsubscribe link.
  • Payment Processing: Credit card and billing details for Monthly Research Pass ($29/mo) and Annual Research Pass ($199/yr) orders are processed exclusively via Whop.com (Global Card / Apple Pay / Google Pay) on PCI-DSS Level 1 infrastructure. TruthOfMarket Research never receives or stores raw credit card numbers.
  • Browser Local Storage: UI preferences (theme, font size, historical study explorer selections, and session state) are stored locally in your own browser's localStorage.

2. Zero Data Selling & Third-Party Sharing

We never sell, rent, or trade your email address or personal data to third-party data brokers or advertisers.

3. Anonymous Aggregate Telemetry

We record anonymous, cookie-free aggregate pageview and interaction counters solely to maintain uptime and improve readability. No cross-site behavioral ad profiling is used.

4. Your Deletion & Access Rights (GDPR / CCPA)

You may unsubscribe in 1 click from any email footer or request immediate deletion or export of your email record at any time by emailing hello@truthofmarket.com. Deletion requests are honored within 48 hours.
